corrections.text: The Overview says the source 'is dedicated to the public domain under CC0, according to the project README.' The README says the software 'is licensed under the CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0-1.0) License, except the code in the vendor/ directory, which is under the Apache License 2.0'; it does not use the words 'public domain'. The public-domain dedication wording comes from Matthew Goldberg's post ('a public dedication under the Creative Commons CC0 license') and from The New Stack and SiliconANGLE.

The scores-file section sets the evaluation suite's 29,676 manifest rows against the scores file's 32,402 behavioral entries. Matching the two lists by test identifier, the Herald's reviewer found that 29,255 of the 32,402 entries match a manifest row, 3,147 entries (including identifiers beginning '_smoke.') have no manifest row, and 421 manifest rows have no entry in the scores file, so the counts describe different sets of tests and not only different sizes.
